items.title: Champagne Maker Taittinger Sells More to a World That’s Drinking Less
items.why: Luxury volume can rise while category demand falls, so track brand-level spend rather than category totals.
items.summary_ai: Champagne house Taittinger is selling more even as worldwide champagne consumption declines.
items.take: Luxury volume can rise while category demand falls, so track brand-level spend rather than category totals.
